fact: The official text of 'Tchad Connexion 2030', signed by the President at N'Djamena on 29 May 2025, is a multisectoral Plan national de développement (4 domains, 17 programmes, 133 projects, 2025-2030 projections) with digital as one component (target 80% internet coverage), not a stand-alone digital strategy; the text is on tchadconnexion2030.td.
title: Tchad Connexion 2030 - Plan de développement - Plan national de développement
publisher: Ministère des Finances, du Budget, de l'Economie, du Plan et de la Coopération Internationale, Tchad
